offline.chipAria: You are offline. Tap for details.

modal.title: You're offline
modal.body: No internet? No problem. Any book you've saved is ready to read. Your highlights, bookmarks, settings, and reading progress are all kept safe on your device and will catch up the moment you reconnect. Anything that needs AI will run once you're online again.

generic.title: This page needs a connection
generic.body: This page isn't available offline. Your library and the books you've saved for offline reading are still available.

home.title: Your dashboard needs a connection
home.body: We couldn't load your home dashboard while offline. Open your library to keep reading the books you've saved — your progress and highlights are safe and will sync when you're back online.

admin.title: Admin tools need a connection
admin.body: The catalog manager only works while you're online. Reconnect to manage the public catalog.

insights.title: Insights need a connection
insights.body: Your reading insights are calculated on the server and need a connection. Your offline reading still counts and will appear here once you reconnect.

toast.swFailed: Offline mode unavailable — pages may not load if your connection drops.
toast.quotaLow: Not enough space to save this book offline — it's still available when you're online.
toast.saveFailed: Couldn't save this book offline. Please try again.

missingBook.title: Open online to save this book
missingBook.body: You can save this book by opening its info page and tapping "Save for offline" when you have an internet connection.

primeConsent.title: Save your books for offline reading?
primeConsent.body: You're on a connection that may use mobile data. Download the books you've marked for offline — with their highlights and notes — so they're ready without a connection?

explore.title: Full catalog browsing lands next
explore.body: Home already surfaces featured books and quick add flows. This dedicated route will expand that into filtering, discovery, and richer metadata exploration.
